test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is: **Mosquitose**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelled word "Mosquitose" should be correctly spelled as **"Mosquitoes"**. (मच्छर)

 
 
• **Example:** Mosquitoes can carry diseases such as malaria and dengue fever.
 
 

Therefore, the correct spelling should be- **Mosquito**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1,** "Professor",** is correctly spelled and refers to a teacher of the highest rank in a college or university. (प्रोफेसर)
 
• Option 3, **"Systematically"**, is correctly spelled and means following a fixed plan or system. (प्रणालीगत रूप से)
 
• Option 4, **"Prophet"**, is correctly spelled and refers to a person regarded as an inspired teacher or proclaimer of the will of God. (नबी)
